clues.text: Reaching a top speed of 67 mph, this coaster stands 164 feet tall and flips riders upside down through 3 inversions.
Manufactured by B&M, this ride first welcomed park guests in 2014.
This massive ride operates in China at a major ocean-themed marine park.
Upon debut, it became the first Wing Coaster built in Asia and the very first coaster of its model to feature a splashdown element.
The attraction takes its name from a colorful tropical bird famous for its ability to mimic human speech.

evidence.quote: Parrot Coaster (formerly known as Flying Over the Rainforest) is a steel Wing Coaster at Chimelong Ocean Kingdom in Zhuhai, Guangdong, China.
Manufactured by Bolliger & Mabillard, upon its opening in 2014, it became the first Wing Coaster in Asia and also features the first splashdown on a Wing Coaster.
